title: English Wikipedia
verification_method: Latest all-article editions listed by official Kiwix OPDS at verification time. Exact byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes come from the official file Metalink records and sizes were confirmed by HTTPS HEAD requests. Archive contents were not downloaded during catalog verification.

options.name: English Wikipedia · full articles with images
options.description: Full-article English Wikipedia collection packaged by Kiwix, with selected article images. Does not include all Wikimedia media or video.

options.name: English Wikipedia · full articles, no images
options.description: Full-article English Wikipedia collection packaged by Kiwix without article images or video. Saves space compared with the image edition.

options.name: English Wikipedia · compact introductions
options.description: Compact English Wikipedia collection with introductory article text. Omits the full article details, images, and video.
